tools.name: execute
tools.title: Execute code
tools.description:
Run JavaScript in a sandbox against the documentation tools on the global `tools` object.
The only extra global is `tools` - there is no `fetch`, `console`, `setTimeout`, `require`, or Node.js API; all I/O goes through `tools`.

Workflow - minimize round-trips; one `describe-tools` call plus one `execute` call covers most requests:
1. Analyze the request and decide which sandbox tools it needs.
2. Call `describe-tools` with those names to get their exact TypeScript signatures - inputs, result shapes, and a worked example. NEVER call `execute` with guessed method names, parameter names, enum values, or result field names: read fields off the declared return types, not from assumptions.
3. Batch everything into a SINGLE script: chain tool calls, pass one call's output into the next, process results in plain JavaScript, and `return` only what the request needs.

Available tools (exact signatures come from `describe-tools`):
- listApis — Lists the APIs documented in this project
- getEndpoints — Get all endpoints for a specific API
- getEndpointInfo — Get comprehensive information about specific endpoint inclu…
- getSecuritySchemes — Get the security schemes for a specific API
- getFullApiDescription — Get the complete OpenAPI description
- search — Search across the documentation to fetch relevant content f…

code.description: JavaScript to run in the sandbox. Return a value to receive it as the result.

description.description: A short, human-readable summary of what this code does.

tools.name: describe-tools
tools.title: Describe tools
tools.description:
Get the exact TypeScript signatures of the sandbox tools available to `execute`.
Analyze the user request first, then pass `tools` with only the tool names the request needs (every name is listed in this input schema / description); omit `tools` only when you cannot tell which tools apply.
Always call this before your first `execute` and never guess signatures. Request every tool the task may need in ONE call instead of calling this repeatedly.
Tool names to describe: listApis, getEndpoints, getEndpointInfo, getSecuritySchemes, getFullApiDescription, search. Omit to describe everything.
